label: conj:p-from-braid-mirror
title: Parity $P$ as mirror reflection of the braid diagram (writhe sign flip)
html:
Within the QOU framework, parity P acts as the mirror reflection of the braid diagram — each positive crossing \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1} and vice versa, with the q-parameter held fixed (q \mapsto q, not q \mapsto q^{-1}). Equivalently, P negates the signed writhe w(K) \mapsto -w(K) of every braid word. P is an involution (P^2 = \mathrm{id}) and is distinct from:

  • the bar-involution Bar-involution and its P_{\mathrm{avg}} / P_{\mathrm{skew}} projections, which acts as q \mapsto q^{-1} AND \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1} simultaneously (= composite CPT);
  • charge conjugation Charge conjugation C as the color-sheet flavor-swap u \leftrightarrow \bar u, d \leftrightarrow \bar d, which acts on color-sheet flavor labels with no Hecke- generator action;
  • time-reversal Time-reversal T as Markov-trace word reversal (trace cyclicity dual), which reverses the braid word at the Markov-trace level.

The action

For a braid word \beta = \sigma_{i_1}^{\epsilon_1} \cdots \sigma_{i_\ell}^{\epsilon_\ell} in B_n (or its image in H_n(q)):

  P \;:\;
  \sigma_{i_k}^{\epsilon_k}
  \;\longmapsto\;
  \sigma_{i_k}^{-\epsilon_k}
  \qquad (q\text{ held fixed}).

On the writhe, this gives w(P\beta) = -w(\beta) — a sign flip on the bar-anti-symmetric writhe quantity classified in bar-involution-table3-data.

Disentangling parity from CPT

The composite bar-involution acts as both:

  (\text{bar}) \;:\;
  \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1},
  \qquad
  q \mapsto q^{-1}.

This is CPT composed: bar = P \cdot C \cdot T in the natural order, where:

Acts on Symbol map
Hecke generator chirality only \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1}, q fixed (= P alone)
Color sheets only flavor u \leftrightarrow \bar u (= C alone)
Markov trace cyclicity only braid word reversal (= T alone)

P alone (this conjecture) corresponds to the first row only — it fixes q, fixes color-sheet flavors, and fixes trace cyclicity; it only mirrors the diagram. Composed with C and T, it recovers the bar-involution.

Structural invariants

  • GB filtration level: ℓ-dependent per-atom (P preserves Coxeter length but flips signs of generators).
  • Jet order: h^0 (P fixes q; no q-deformation parameter enters the P action).
  • Bar-symmetry status: bar-trivial (P does not act on q; bar-involution acts on q AND \sigma_i, so P alone is a strict sub-action).

Writhe w(K) (the observable that P negates) is classified in bar-involution-table3-data as bar-anti-symmetric, consistent: bar reverses writhe via the composite P \cdot C \cdot T, of which P is the writhe-acting factor.

Scope at the Hecke-letter level

P as written is a map on braid words, not on H_n(q). The conjecture defines P by \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1} with q held fixed. On the braid group B_n this is an involution. It does not descend to the Hecke algebra: an algebra map of H_n(q) that is linear over the scalars and sends a generator to its inverse forces 2(q - q^{-1}) = 0, so it exists only when q^2 = 1 in characteristic other than 2. The reason is that \sigma_i^{-1} satisfies the Hecke relation at the parameter q^{-1}, not at q.

What does descend. Let P_+ and P_- be the idempotents of \sigma_i for its eigenvalues q and -q^{-1}, and let e^- = \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 with mirror e^+ = \sigma_0^{-1}\sigma_1^{-1}\sigma_0^{-1}, as in the Breit–Wheeler vertex. Three involutions send a letter to a letter, and they form a Klein four-group.

  • The mirror \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1} together with q \mapsto q^{-1} is the bar involution on a letter. It keeps P_+ and P_- and sends e^- to e^+. Its profile is that of C, or of CT if q \mapsto q^{-1} is read as antilinear.
  • The map \sigma_i \mapsto -\sigma_i^{-1} keeps q, exchanges P_+ and P_-, and sends e^- to -e^+. Its profile is that of CP.
  • The map \sigma_i \mapsto -\sigma_i together with q \mapsto q^{-1} exchanges P_+ and P_- and sends e^- to -e^-. It is the only one of the three with the profile of P. It is not linear over the scalars unless q^2 = 1, and q \mapsto q^{-1} has no counterpart at the real substrate value q_0.

The bar involution as composite CPT. At the letter level the bar involution keeps both eigenlines. A map with the profile of CPT would exchange them, as P does. So the factorisation bar = P \cdot C \cdot T in the summary below is not supported at the letter level, where bar has the profile of C (or CT).

Item 1 below. Multiplying (\sigma_i - q)(\sigma_i + q^{-1}) = 0 by \sigma_i^{-2} gives (\sigma_i^{-1})^2 = (q^{-1} - q)\,\sigma_i^{-1} + 1, which is the Hecke relation at q^{-1}. The quadratic at q is therefore not preserved by P with q fixed.

The hypothesis in summary

The conjecture asserts an involution P on braid-group elements (P^2 = \mathrm{id}) sending each Hecke generator \sigma_i to \sigma_i^{-1}, fixing q, and such that the bar-involution factors as P \circ C \circ T.

Consumers / downstream

  • The writhe-based chirality classification Chirality factor 1 + w \cdot h from ribbon-twist framing (writhe w) gets a categorical home: chirality measures the P-anti-symmetric part of a knot, separately from C and T.

What remains open

  1. Invariance of the Hecke quadratic under P. The quadratic is preserved (since both \sigma_i and \sigma_i^{-1} satisfy the same relation): the quadratic (\sigma_i - q)(\sigma_i + q^{-1}) = 0 is invariant under P because (\sigma_i^{-1} - q)(\sigma_i^{-1} + q^{-1}) = 0 also holds (multiply the original by \sigma_i^{-2}).
  2. Closing the conjecture needs the existence of such a map P, and a derivation of bar = P \cdot C \cdot T as an identity rather than an assumption.

Cross-references

  • The sibling \mathbb{Z}/2 factors of CPT — charge conjugation and time reversal, this conjecture supplying parity: Charge conjugation C as the color-sheet flavor-swap u \leftrightarrow \bar u, d \leftrightarrow \bar d, Time-reversal T as Markov-trace word reversal (trace cyclicity dual)
  • Bar-involution: Bar-involution and its P_{\mathrm{avg}} / P_{\mathrm{skew}} projections Tables 1-4
